::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [May 1877]  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 17
:::

Miss Yonge would be obliged if [Messrs Macmillan](organizations/other_111.qmd) would send copies of each of her works to 

Sister Elizabeth
[St Mary’s](organizations/other_21.qmd) Home
Wantage

Also one copy of [the Heir of Redclyffe](cmy_books/cmybook_15.qmd) for herself

---

**Note:** Endorsed ‘Rail/28 5/77’ and (against ‘herself’) ‘Post 28/5/77’.
